title: Your 10th Claude message is 10x slower than your 1st.
description:
Every time you hit send, Claude reads the entire conversation back from message one. Message ten costs ten. Message twenty costs twenty. By the time you've been working four hours, every send is rereading thousands of tokens you've already paid for. The model isn't slower. The arithmetic is. Use /clear before noon.

#claude #claudecode #aitips #context #shorts
